REQ-0020.Requirement: The system shall clearly indicate the state of the document being viewed

Revision (major only), 
Document Title, 
Document Type, 
Document Owner, 
the associated AR ID, 
Document Status, and 
Effective Date

REQ-0040.Requirement: The system should provide a mechanism to export the Document List (e.g. to a .csv format)

REQ-0090.Requirement: The system shall default to the Document List being sorted by most recent edited first

REQ-0100.Requirement: The system shall provide a mechanism to clear all Document List filters

REQ-0110.Requirement: The system shall display the number of documents displayed that match the filter settings

REQ-0120.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to open a document from within the Document List

REQ-0130.Requirement: The system should display the description of the document when the mouse hovers over the document title in the Document List

REQ-0140.Requirement: The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to create a document from the Document List landing page

REQ-0150.Requirement: The system shall allow a user to revise a document that is in the Released state

REQ-0160.Requirement: The system shall provide the following editable document attributes when creating or revising a document: (Document Title, Document Description, Document Type, Document Revision Stage, Reference, Training Required, Attachments, Users (document access privileges), Groups (document access privileges), Document Owner Assignment)

REQ-0170.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to edit document ID, when creating a document.

REQ-0180.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to add one or more references to a document in draft state

REQ-0190.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to remove references to a document in draft state

REQ-0200.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to upload one or more attachments to a document in draft state

REQ-0210.Requirement: The system support attachments of multiple types.

REQ-0220.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to upload multiple documents at once

REQ-0230.Requirement: The system shall notify the user if a document upload failure occurs

REQ-0240.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to remove uploaded attachments for a document in draft state

REQ-0250.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to identify a single attachment as the primary attachment for a document

REQ-0260.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to identify any attachment as a redline

REQ-0270.Requirement: The system shall default the training to required, if the particular Document Type requires training in the Document Approval Matrix

REQ-0280.Requirement: The system shall default the training to required, if the  previous revision of the particular document required training

REQ-0290.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to deselect training required,  if the default state was training required

REQ-0300.Requirement: The system shall default user/group access to Everyone for new documents

REQ-0320.Requirement: The system shall automatically generate and display a document number when a document is created based on the system configuration for the particular Document Type

REQ-0330.Requirement: The system shall automatically set the document status as Draft when creating or revising a document

REQ-0340.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to change document ownership to another user

REQ-0350.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to cancel the document draft.  A confirmation dialog is required.

REQ-0360.Requirement: The system shall maintain a history of attribute changes

REQ-0370.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to select the type of revision change, options include next revision, upgrade revision state, administrative, or obsolete, when revising a document and if the option is applicable.

REQ-0380.Requirement: The system shall require a password for a user to access attachments of documents if the document is in Obsolete state

REQ-0390.Requirement: The system shall require a password for a user to access redlines of documents if the document is not in draft state

REQ-0400.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to create a Document Type

REQ-0410.Requirement: The system shall support multiple Document Types as needed by the customer

REQ-0420.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to define a Document Type as QMS or non-QMS. QMS default access everyone and Non-QMS default access only owner

REQ-0440.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to assign a document prefix to a Document Type at the time of creation of the Document Type

REQ-0450.Requirement: The system shall support a sequential numbering by company or by prefix for each Document Type. A starting number will be set per document type.

REQ-0460.Requirement: The system shall support multiple Document Types to share the same prefix. All documents sharing the same prefix shall share sequential numbering system

REQ-0480.Requirement: The system shall maintain a descriptive name for every Document Type

REQ-0490.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to assign a Document Type to an Enlil Document Class

REQ-0510.Requirement: When viewing the Document List, only Document Types defined as Enlil Document Class of Document shall be visible

REQ-0520.Requirement: The Document Approval Matrix shall be enforced for managing approvals to all Enlil Document Classes and Admin changes to POs

REQ-0530.Requirement: For Document Types assigned to an Enlil Document Class of Document, the system shall include the Document Type in the Document List, and utilizes the Document Approval Matrix to manage changes/approvals

REQ-0550.Requirement: For items with an Enlil Document Class of Dynamic Form, the system shall include these Document Types as selectable items when creating custom forms

REQ-0560.Requirement: For items with an Enlil Document Class of PI, the system shall allow addition of these Document Types as process instructions on electronic LHR's

REQ-0570.Requirement: For items with an Enlil Document Class of PO, the system shall display these Document Types on the PO List, and utilize PO approval matrix to manage changes/approvals

REQ-0580.Requirement: The system shall only display the major revision of a document, except for in the revision history of the document

REQ-0590.Requirement: The system shall support the creation of roles (e.g.: QA, R&D, RA…etc.)

REQ-0600.Requirement: The system shall allow the assignment of user groups to roles and users to roles

REQ-0630.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to assign approval requirements per role for each Document Type

REQ-0640.Requirement: The system shall allow separate assignment of approval requirements for a 2-level document system with revision types: Numeric and Alpha

REQ-0670.Requirement: The system shall allow the assignment of approval requirements for a Admin Revision change

REQ-0680.Requirement: The system shall allow users to create and submit approval requests for approval/obsolescence of documents.

REQ-0690.Requirement: The system shall automatically issue a unique approval request ID when a new change request is initiated

REQ-0700.Requirement: The system shall support the customer to define one or more custom forms to be used for approval requests

REQ-0710.Requirement: The system shall support addition of one or more implementation tasks to the AR form, including a task title, task description, task assignment to user, due data, and status tracking, that are required to complete before an AR is closed

REQ-0730.Requirement:
The system shall automatically maintain the status of a change request:
Draft - the default state when created
In Review - the state where the change request is in review by the approvers
Approved - the state where the change request has been approved by all reviewers
Implementation - the state where the change request has pending Implementation Task(s)
Closed - the state when an approved change request has been fully implemented by doc control

REQ-0740.Requirement:
The system shall automatically update the status attribute of all documents/parts on the approval request when the state of the approval request changes:
Pending Change when the AR is in Draft State
In Review when the AR is in In Review State
Approved when the AR is in Approved State 
Approved when the AR is in Implementation State
Released when the AR is in Closed State

REQ-0750.Requirement:
The system shall display the following default columns on the landing page for the approvals list: 
AR ID, 
AR Title, 
AR Owner, and 
AR  State (e.g. this list defines content, not column header names)

REQ-0760.Requirement: The system shall only display document approval requests in the approval requests list (e.g. approvals for other items like PO's can be found in their respective modules)

REQ-0770.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed approval request list for each of the columns displayed on the landing page

REQ-0780.Requirement: The system shall default the approval request list filter to display AR's with latest edited displaying on top when starting a new Enlil session

REQ-0790.Requirement: The system shall maintain approval request list filter settings during an Enlil session when navigating away from and back to the approval request list landing page

REQ-0800.Requirement: The system shall default to the approval request list being sorted by most recent edited first

REQ-0810.Requirement: The system shall provide a mechanism to clear all approval request list filters

REQ-0820.Requirement: The system shall display the number of approval requests displayed that match the filter settings

REQ-0830.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to open an AR from the AR list

REQ-0840.Requirement: The system should display the AR description when the mouse hovers over the AR title in the approval request list

REQ-0850.Requirement: The system shall allow the originator to edit the approval request and any documents associated with the approval request only while it is in draft or rejected states

REQ-0860.Requirement: The system shall prevent the addition of documents that are already included on another approval request

REQ-0870.Requirement: The system shall determine the approver requirements based on the document approval matrix for all documents contained on an AR.

REQ-0880.Requirement: The system shall enforce approval requirements prior to document release if the Document Type requires e-signature. If not met, an exception shall be visible

REQ-0890.Requirement: The system shall allow the owner of an AR to withdraw an AR that is in In Review State

REQ-0900.Requirement: For "no e-signature required" documents, approvals shall be enforced based on the users invited to approve the document by the document owner.

REQ-0910.Requirement: The system shall provide a mechanism for electronic approvals (e.g. PO's, change requests, training forms, NCMR, CAPA, user profiles)

REQ-0920.Requirement: The system shall require the user to enter their user password when approving or rejecting an approval request that is assigned to them

REQ-0940.Requirement: The system shall allow the owner of an AR to change an approver on the AR to another user, provided that user meets the criteria of the approval matrix

REQ-2700.Requirement: The system shall automatically change the status of a document to "Released" when the AR is approved and the effective date is met

REQ-2710.Requirement: The system shall automatically change the status of an AR to "Closed", when all document(s) have been Released (once the effective date is met) and all implementation task(s) have been closed

REQ-2720.Requirement: The system shall provide the  user the ability to set the Effective Date on an Express AR if there are no pending actions

REQ-0960.Requirement: The system shall record (audit trail) the date and timestamp for approval and rejections by a user

REQ-2730.Requirement: The system shall record (audit trail) the date and timestamp for AR closure (only when the system verifies that the AR is Closed)

REQ-0970.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to create custom forms, for the purpose of creating quality system records.  (e.g. forms for lot history, equipment calibration and maintenance, supplier management, etc.)

The system shall display the following default columns on the landing page for the records list: 
ID, 
Revision, 
State, 
Title, 
Form ID, 
Owner, 
Released Date and 
Form ID

REQ-2750.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed Record List for each of the columns displayed on the landing page

REQ-2760.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to open a record from within the Records List

REQ-2770.Requirement: The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to create a record from the Records List landing page

REQ-0980.Requirement: The system shall provide the ability to add approvals fields within the Form

REQ-0990.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to define whether form approvals (Inline Approvals) are blocking (required before performing subsequent sections)

REQ-1000.Requirement: The system shall maintain an audit trail of changes to records, including the user making the change, the date and time of the change, and identification of the content that was changed.

REQ-1010.Requirement: The system shall record (audit trail) the date and timestamp for approval and rejections (if applicable) of a record by a user

REQ-1020.Requirement: The system shall create new records at numeric revision stage for forms that include Inline Approval

REQ-1030.Requirement: The system shall create new records at the alpha revision stage for forms that do not include inline approval

REQ-1040.Requirement: The system shall create a new revision for every inline approval

REQ-1050.Requirement: The system shall indicate that a section of the form has been modified after approval, for forms that include Inline Approval

REQ-1060.Requirement: The system shall create and upgrade the revision stage to Alpha when all inline approvals for a form have been recorded - close and finalize is needed

REQ-1080.Requirement: The system shall allow the owner for updates to the record in parallel with the approval process for forms that include Inline Approval

REQ-1090.Requirement: If a record section is edited after approval, the record has been subsequently updated during the approval process, if the record is rejected, the updates made to the record since submission are copied into the record

REQ-1100.Requirement: If a record is submitted for approval of a particular section, and edits are made to another section, once the record is approved, the updates made to the record are copied into the new draft of the record, for forms that include Inline Approval

REQ-1110.Requirement: The system shall only display the major revision of a record, except for in the revision history of the record

REQ-2780.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to update a record after alpha release  (inline or regular) and follow the  Document Approval Matrix to manage approvals

REQ-2790.Requirement: For Document Types assigned to an Enlil Document Class of Record, the system shall include the Document Type in the Records List

REQ-2800.Requirement: The system should allow the user to Void a record.

REQ-2490.Requirement: The system shall allow the company administrator to create users in the system

REQ-2500.Requirement: The system shall allow the company administrator to create or edit groups in the system

REQ-2510.Requirement: The system shall allow the company administrator to add or remove users to groups

REQ-2520.Requirement: The system shall provide the default groups for allocating system permissions

REQ-2530.Requirement: The system shall provide a group called Everyone consisting of all users

REQ-2550.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to create (UNOFFICIAL) groups in the system

REQ-2560.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to add other users to (UNOFFICIAL) groups in the system (provided they are the owner of the group)

REQ-2570.Requirement: The system shall provide a list of groups that have been created

REQ-2600.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed groups for each of the columns displayed on the group landing page

REQ-2630.Requirement: The system shall provide the following group types (Official and Unofficial)

REQ-2640.Requirement: The system shall allow the generation of accurate and complete copies of documents and records in both human readable and electronic form suitable for inspection, review, and copying. This includes the complete record and all change history. This is applicable to released and previous revisions of documents and records.

REQ-2650.Requirement: The system shall allow only authorized individuals with appropriate access rights to access documentation stored in Enlil.

REQ-2660.Requirement: The system shall allow only authorized individuals who have a valid Enlil login to access the system

REQ-2670.Requirement: The system shall use of secure, computer-generated, time-stamped audit trails to independently record the date and time of operator entries and actions that create, modify, or delete electronic records.

REQ-2680.Requirement: The audit trail shall ensure that previously recorded information are not deleted or obscured and available for review through revision history

REQ-2690.Requirement: The audit trail documentation shall be retained for a period at least as long as that required for the subject electronic records.

REQ-3890.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to only receive once against a line item in an RC

REQ-3900.Requirement: The system shall not create lots for received line items automatically

REQ-3910.Requirement: The system shall now allow the user to receive against a released RC

REQ-3920.Requirement: The System shall provide the ability to produce the entire content of the record in human-readable form, including audit trails and electronic signatures.

REQ-3930.Requirement: The system shall restrict access to authorized users.

REQ-3940.Requirement: The system shall enforce unique User IDs or a similarly secure mechanism (e.g., fingerprint).

REQ-3950.Requirement: The system shall store passwords in a non-human-readable form.

REQ-3960.Requirement: The system shall prevent unauthorized access when system is left unattended for a predetermined length of time.

REQ-3970.Requirement: The system should lock a user account when the number of consecutive failed login attempts exceeds the established limit.

REQ-3980.Requirement: The system shall provide functionality to set user access privileges.

REQ-3990.Requirement: The system shall limit user functions to their assigned privileges.

REQ-4000.Requirement: The system shall automatically generate an audit trail to independently record the modification of records and include the modification date, time, who, and the previous data value for each modified regulated record.

REQ-4010.Requirement: The system shall automatically generate an audit trail to independently record the deletion of records and include the deletion date, time, who and the data values for each deleted regulated record.

REQ-4020.Requirement: The system shall enforce required sequencing of steps or events, i.e., a draft cannot be released without an approval step.

REQ-4030.Requirement: The system shall have the ability to produce in human- readable form all information associated with the signing (including full name, date, time, and meaning (such as review, approval, responsibility, or authorship) of signature).

REQ-4040.Requirement: The system shall record the date/time when an electronic signature is executed.

REQ-4050.Requirement: The system shall include the meaning of an electronic signature when executed (e.g., verified, approved, rejected, batch release).

REQ-4060.Requirement: The system shall prevent the alteration of an electronic signature.

REQ-4070.Requirement: The system shall ensure the electronic signature is linked to the respective electronic record.

REQ-4080.Requirement: The system shall ensure the electronic signature ID for each authorized user is unique.

REQ-4090.Requirement: The system shall prevent the electronic signature ID for an authorized user from being re-assigned.

REQ-4100.Requirement: The system shall prevent the electronic signature ID from being deleted.

REQ-4110.Requirement: The system shall enable the electronic signature ID to be activated.

REQ-4120.Requirement: The system shall ensure that ID codes/passwords maintain the uniqueness of each combination such that no 2 individuals ever have the same password/code.

REQ-4130.Requirement: Documented procedures shall describe methods to prevent reassignment of signature components, i.e., any component of the electronic signature cannot be reassigned to another user.

REQ-4140.Requirement: The system shall require 2 distinct identification components when applying an electronic signature (e.g., User ID & Password).

REQ-4150.Requirement: The system shall enforce that at least one electronic signature component is confidential and secure (e.g. password or PIN).

REQ-4160.Requirement: The system shall require 2 distinct identification components during the initial signing, for multiple continuous signing sessions.

REQ-4170.Requirement: The system shall require a confidential and secure identification component during subsequent continuous signing sessions.

REQ-4180.Requirement: The system should force passwords to be changed at a predefined interval.

REQ-4190.Requirement: The system shall provide the ability to deactivate the electronic signature ID.

REQ-4200.Requirement: The system should prevent password re-use within an established limit.

REQ-4210.Requirement: The System shall all for the control of documents required by the Quality Management system (creation, approval, control, change, obsolescence).

REQ-4220.Requirement: The System shall allow for the designation of individual(s) to review for adequacy and approve prior to issuance all documents. Designation may be performed through department functions, roles, user groups, etc.

REQ-4230.Requirement: The System should record the approval of the of designation of individual(s) that review and approve documents.

REQ-4240.Requirement: The System shall control the individual(s) with authority to approve or change the of designation of individual(s) to review and approve documents.

REQ-4250.Requirement: The System shall create an electronic record and audit trail, including the date and electronic signature of the individual(s) approving the document.

REQ-4260.Requirement: The System shall ensure that obsolete documents are promptly removed from all points of use or otherwise prevented from use.

REQ-4270.Requirement: The System shall ensure that changes to documents are reviewed and approved by an individual(s) in the same function or organization that performed the original review and approval, unless specifically designated otherwise.

REQ-4280.Requirement: The System shall ensure that change records include a description of the change.

REQ-4290.Requirement: The System shall ensure that change records include identification of the affected documents.

REQ-4300.Requirement: The System shall ensure that change records include the approval date.

REQ-4310.Requirement: The System shall ensure that change records include the date when the change becomes effective.

REQ-4320.Requirement: The System shall allow for the identification and control of documents of external origin -- ensure that documents of external origin, determined by the organization to be necessary for the planning and operation of the quality management system, are identified and their distribution controlled

REQ-4330.Requirement: The System shall allow for the control of records required by the Quality Management system

REQ-4340.Requirement: The System shall allow for the designation of individual(s) to approve prior to issuance all records. Designation may be performed through department functions, roles, user groups, etc.

REQ-4350.Requirement: The System shall record the approval of the designation of individual(s) that review and approve records.

REQ-4360.Requirement: The System shall control the individual(s) with authority to approve or change the of designation of individual(s) to review and approve records.

REQ-4370.Requirement: The System shall create an electronic record and audit trail, including the date and electronic signature of the individual(s) approving the record (including for record creation and record corrections).

REQ-4380.Requirement: The System shall ensure that records cannot be obsoleted once a record has been approved and released.

REQ-4390.Requirement: The System shall ensure that changes to records are reviewed and approved by an individual(s) in the same function or organization that performed the original review and approval, unless specifically designated otherwise. --- The System shall allow correction of records to be reviewed and approved by designated individuals or roles

REQ-4400.Requirement: The System shall ensure that change records include the date when the change is approved and released.
